tests.name: test_create_and_get_bundle_with_filter_unread_and_filter_shared
tests.reason: POST with explicit values must persist and be returned by GET detail; a bundle posted without them returns "off" for both. Fails before the change because the fields are absent.

tests.name: test_patch_bundle_changes_filter_fields_and_keeps_others
tests.reason: PATCH changes one or both fields, a following GET shows them, and name/search/tags remain unchanged; a PATCH of only one field leaves the other as it was.

tests.name: test_bookmarks_by_bundle_filter_unread_yes_no_off
tests.reason: Fixture has read and unread bookmarks that all match the bundle's search. The test asserts the exact result set for "yes", "no" and "off" on GET /api/bookmarks/?bundle=<id>. Before the change the filter is ignored, so "yes" and "no" fail.

tests.name: test_bookmarks_by_bundle_filter_shared_yes_no_off
tests.reason: Same as above for shared and unshared bookmarks, with the unread state kept constant so only sharing varies.

tests.name: test_bookmarks_by_bundle_combines_unread_shared_search_and_tags
tests.reason: Bookmarks cover all four unread/shared combinations. Some fail only the search or only the tag condition. Only the one that meets every condition may be returned. The same bundle is also loaded through /bookmarks?bundle=<id> and the page's bookmark list is checked.

tests.name: test_create_and_edit_bundle_with_reading_and_sharing_state
tests.reason: One user path. On /bundles/new the test checks the "Reading State" (All, Unread, Read) and "Sharing State" (All, Shared, Unshared) dropdowns, picks Unread and Shared, and sees the "Found N bookmarks" preview change. It saves, opens /bookmarks?bundle=<id> to check that only matching bookmarks are listed, then reopens the edit form to confirm both selections are preselected. Fixtures make the counts differ between All and the filtered choices.

structured.placement_reason: The criteria are about data and filtering, so AC1–AC5 go in one new API test file, bookmarks/tests/test_bundle_reading_sharing_filters_api.py, per the strategy (API level is most of the coverage). It uses LinkdingApiTestCase and BookmarkFactoryMixin. AC5's page half is checked with self.client against /bookmarks?bundle=<id>, which avoids a browser test. AC6 is the only user-visible form flow, so it gets a single new e2e file, bookmarks/tests_e2e/e2e_test_bundle_reading_sharing_filters.py, using LinkdingE2ETestCase. No developer tests were visible and the diff was empty. I did not plan tests for the ambiguities (invalid values, PUT semantics, interaction with q), because the ticket does not define the expected behaviour. Unit tests are left to the implementer.
